quest.title: The Culling of the Worms: Introduction
quest.description: Near the meeting spot with the two researchers, you hear a quarrel in the distance...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventurer's Experience x2, Wanderer's Advice x4

dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: ...So why did you order customized rivets? They don't improve performance at all, do they?

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: ...Riveted armor is a symbol of romance for us Kshahrewar researchers!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You guys... have been at it since yesterday?

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: Ah, you're already here! Not exactly. We actually had the debate about funding yesterday.

dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: Hmph... We were actually arguing about something else. But before I knew it, we went right back to arguing about funding...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Something else?

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: I've polished the seams of the components until they are shiny and sparkly, but Shriya's trying to abandon the plan!

dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: Abandon!? I just want a temporary pause!

dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: Didn't you notice that there's something wrong with the environmental parameters? If we continue with the assembly, the charging efficiency of the device will be much lower than expected.

dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: We need to figure out what's going on in this area, eliminate all external influences, then proceed with assembly as planned.

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: There are plenty of situations where the ideal and actual circumstances don't match. There's no need to be so fussy.

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: I took the margin of error in consideration when I drafted the blueprint, so it's not a big deal at all.

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: Besides, sometimes you have to test things out before you can figure out what the problem is.

dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: ...Is that why you tested Experimental Device No. 2 until it exploded that other year?

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: That... that was different! I didn't realize the need to leave room for error back then...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Is there a safer way to do this?

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: I'm thinking... Maybe we could first switch off the turret's firing function and just do a simulated experiment of its charging process?

dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: ...That won't do, I don't trust your judgment on this. Let's get rid of the turret ignition module, and I'll safeguard it for you. You can install the other components however you please.

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: Remove the ignition module!? Then the Wenutslayer Cannon will just be one big paperweight!

dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: Didn't you say we'd just do an experimental simulation of the charging process? At the end of the day, you're still thinking about firing that cannon!

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: Uhh...

choices.text: Let's just disable the firing function.

response.speaker: Vinayak
response.text: Well, all right... Let's think of it as a "trial assembly."

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: If only you'd have said this earlier... I expect a lot of monsters to be attracted during the installation process. When the moment comes, we'll be counting on you, adventurer.

choices.text: Maybe start by building the framework?
